draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Karwar! Right on Rabindranath Tagore Beach sits INS Chapal, a real Indian Navy missile boat turned into a museum ship you can walk through.
draft.hungryLine: Karwar is all about seafood, and save room for a "Gadbad" ice cream afterwards.

moodReplies.show-me-around: INS Chapal and the Warship And Aircraft Museum are about a 10 min walk, with the Tupolev TU142 right there too. Sadashivgad fort is up by the Kali river bridge.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Climb the Sadashivgad hill in the evening and watch the sun set over the Arabian Sea.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Before the Konkan Railway, buses from Mumbai ran with the route name Bombay Central - Sadashivgad, after the fort here.

legends.title: Where Karwar got its name
legends.body: Locals trace the name Karwar back to Kadwad, a village on a tributary of the Kali. It was once a busy trade port, with a big mosque visited by traders from Arabia and Africa.

legends.title: Bombay Central to Sadashivgad
legends.body: For Konkani speakers coming home from Mumbai, Sadashivgad was the name everyone knew. The buses on this route carried it as their destination board.

tips.title: Catch the sunset from the hill.
tips.body: From the top of Sadashivgad hill, the sun setting into the Arabian Sea is an experience in itself.

tips.title: Get out on the water.
tips.body: Karwar's beaches are good for snorkelling and banana boat rides.

story.title: A port at Kadwad
story.body: The British once had a factory at Kadwad, an important trade port up the Kali. Traders from Arabia and Africa came to its large mosque.

story.title: Sadashivgad is born
story.body: Basavlingraj, a chieftain of Sonda, named the fort Sadashivgad after his father in 1715. Material from the old Karwar fort was used to build it.

story.title: Pulled down
story.body: East India Company General Matthews tore down most of Sadashivgad in 1783. It has been in ruins ever since.

story.title: A coastal capital
story.body: Karwar was once part of the Bombay Presidency. It's now the headquarters of Uttara Kannada district, at the mouth of the Kali on the Konkan Coast.

story.title: Ships and planes
story.body: The missile boat INS Chapal now sits on a concrete platform on Rabindranath Tagore Beach. Inside, mannequins of the captain and crew and replica missiles bring it to life.
